name: Attack Helicopter Dating Simulator
source:
As a helicopter, your daily activities may include, morning maintenance, aerial attack runs, and delivering (hell-fire missiles on noncombatants) democracy.

Or you know, dating other helicopters. It is a visual novel after all...

Attack Helicopter Dating Simulator is made by 'Cursebox Studios', and published by 'DEVGRU-P' the team who brought you games memes like "Panzermadels: Tank Dating Simulator" and "Stay! Stay! Democratic People's Republic of Korea!". Hilarious and with eight endings (where you probably don't die).

Join the Airforce.
See the World
Meet Fun and Interesting Helicopters.
Perform aerial strafing maneuvers against them.
We made Panzermadels, take that as you will.
translation:
作为一架直升机，你的日常活动可能包括早上维护、空中攻击和运送（对非战斗人员发射地狱火导弹）民主。

或者你知道，与其他直升机约会。毕竟是视觉小说……

攻击直升机约会模拟器由“Cursebox Studios”制作，由“DEVGRU-P”团队发行，该团队为你带来了“Panzermadels：坦克约会模拟器”和“Stay！Stay！朝鲜民主主义人民共和国！”等游戏模因。搞笑且有八个结局（你可能不会死）。

加入空军。
看世界
认识有趣的直升机。
对他们进行空中扫射。
我们制造了Panzermadels，你随意吧。
